post.description:
Change the mandate amount or end date of a subscription. Send `amount`, `end_date` or both. Cashfree changes the amount only, so send `amount`. The start date cannot be changed.

On EximPe, the change is sent to the buyer's UPI app to approve. The response has `approval_pending: true`, and the subscription keeps its current terms until the buyer approves.

`ADHOC`, `CANCELLED` and `EXPIRED` subscriptions cannot be modified.

post.description:
Before each charge on a PayU or EximPe subscription, send this notification. It tells the buyer the debit date and amount. Then call [Trigger Recurring Payment](/api-reference/v3/subscriptions/recurring-payment) **on** `debit_date` (IST).

Cashfree subscriptions do not use this endpoint. See [How charging works by payment partner](/integration-guide/v3/web-integration/manage-subscriptions#how-charging-works-by-payment-partner).

**When to call**

- **PayU:** `debit_date` must be after today (IST).
- **EximPe:** at least 24 hours before `debit_date` starts (IST). Example: sent at 10:00 on 5 Nov, the earliest `debit_date` is 7 Nov.
- More than one notification can be active, each for a different future date. A new one must be for a date **later** than every active one.

requestBody.description: The upcoming debit's date, amount and invoice display number.

400.description: A field is invalid, the mandate is not active, or (EximPe) the notification is less than 24 hours before the debit date starts; `details.error` then names the earliest debit date you can use (`ERR_PAYMENT_001`)

details.debit_date: debit_date must be greater than today

details.invoice_display_number: invoice_display_number is required for card subscriptions

details.amount: Pre-debit amount must be less than or equal to the subscription billing amount

403.description: Your merchant account is suspended or closed (`ERR_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_003`)

409.description: A notification is already active for the same or a later date (`ERR_PAYMENT_001`)

details.pre_debit: A charge is already initiated for 2026-12-05; a new one must be for a later date.

details.error: An unexpected error occurred while sending pre-debit notification

502.description: PayU refused the notification (`ERR_PAYMENT_003`), or the payment partner could not be reached (`ERR_GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE`)

StandingInstruction.description: Standing instruction configuration for a subscription

billing_currency.description: Currency for billing amount (provide the ISO code)

billing_cycle.description: How often the debit repeats. ADHOC means there is no schedule — you charge the mandate yourself through Trigger Recurring Payment.

billing_interval.description: Number of billing cycle units between each recurring payment. For example, if billing_cycle is MONTHLY and billing_interval is 2, payments recur every 2 months. If billing_cycle is DAILY and billing_interval is 7, payments recur every 7 days. If billing_cycle is YEARLY and billing_interval is 1, payments recur every year. Required unless `billing_cycle` is `ADHOC`.

payment_start_date.description: First debit date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be later than today in IST. Required for every `billing_cycle`, `ADHOC` included.

payment_end_date.description: Last date the mandate stays valid (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be on or after `payment_start_date`. Required for every `billing_cycle`, `ADHOC` included.

billing_date.description: Day of the debit: 1 to 31 for the day of the month. On `WEEKLY`, 1 to 7 for Monday to Sunday. Optional.

billing_limit.description: Whether the debit runs on, before or after the billing date. Optional; defaults to `AFTER`.

billing_rule.description: `MAX`: each debit is up to `billing_amount`. `EXACT`: each debit is exactly `billing_amount`. Optional; defaults to `MAX`.

auto_refund_mandate.description: Cashfree only. Whether the mandate authorisation amount is refunded once the mandate is set up.

collection_mode.description: Payment collection mode (must be 's2s' for subscriptions)

purpose_code.description: FEMA/FETERS purpose code this order settles under (e.g. S0802). Optional — derived from the merchant's allowed purpose codes when omitted and exactly one is allowed.

business_model.description: Whether the buyer is a business (B2B) or a consumer (B2C). Optional — derived from the merchant's KYC when omitted.

return_url.description: Optional. Where the buyer is sent when the payment step finishes.

number.description: Card number (will be tokenized for security)

token.description: Saved card token. Send it with `identifier` instead of the full card details.

identifier.description: The buyer identifier the card was saved under. Send it with `token`.

save_card.description: Whether to save the card for later use. Optional; defaults to `false`.

acstemplate.description: Base64-encoded ACS template for 3D Secure authentication

message.description: A message from the payment partner, when it returns one.

intent_uri.description: UPI Intent URI for mandate approval

url.description: Full UPI URL for QR code scanning

ModifySubscriptionMandateRequest.description: Send `amount`, `end_date` or both. Cashfree changes the amount only, so send `amount`. The start date cannot be changed.

end_date.description: New mandate end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be on or after the start date.

card_details.description: **Required for PayU card subscriptions.** Not needed for UPI subscriptions.

updated_amount.description: The new mandate amount as a string. `null` while the change awaits the buyer's approval (EximPe).

updated_end_date.description: PayU and EximPe. The new mandate end date, when you sent one. `null` while the change awaits the buyer's approval (EximPe).

updated_start_date.description: EximPe. `null` while the change awaits the buyer's approval.

subscription_status.description: The subscription's status after the call.

message.description: PayU. The payment partner's message, when it returns one.

approval_pending.description: EximPe. `true` when the change awaits the buyer's approval in their UPI app. The subscription keeps its current terms until then.

mandate_update_id.description: EximPe. Identifier of the change awaiting approval.

requested_amount.description: EximPe. The amount you asked for, as a string.

requested_end_date.description: EximPe. The end date you asked for (YYYY-MM-DD).

approve_by.description: EximPe. The last day the buyer can approve the change (YYYY-MM-DD).

mandate_is_active.description: Whether the mandate is currently active. Only act on the subscription when this is true.

status.description: The mandate status as reported by the payment partner. Values and casing vary by partner. Use `mandate_is_active` to decide whether the mandate is live.

gateway_status.description: The payment partner's own mandate status. Returned for some mandates.

amount.description: Mandate amount. Returned when the payment partner provides it.

mandate_start_date.description: Mandate start date. Returned when the payment partner provides it.

mandate_end_date.description: Mandate end date. Returned when the payment partner provides it.

status.description: The subscription's status. `PENDING` until the buyer approves the mandate.

MandateCardDetails.description: Card details for a card subscription. Send `network` plus either `card_token` with `identifier`, or the full card details.

card_token.description: Saved card token. Send it with `identifier`.

identifier.description: The buyer identifier the card was saved under.

card_details.description: **Required for AMEX card subscriptions**, with `network` set to `AMEX`. Not needed for other subscriptions.

debit_date.description: The day you will trigger the charge (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be after today (IST).

amount.description: Up to 12 digits with 2 decimals, minimum `0.01`, at most the subscription's `billing_amount`. Defaults to `billing_amount`. The charge on `debit_date` cannot exceed it.

invoice_display_number.description: **Required on PayU**, card and UPI: Trigger Recurring Payment must repeat it. Optional on EximPe; if you leave it out, one is assigned and returned. Use a new value for each charge, and send the same value to Trigger Recurring Payment.

amount.description: The notified amount, as a string. The charge on `debit_date` cannot exceed it.

invoice_display_number.description: The invoice display number for this charge. Send the same value to Trigger Recurring Payment.

clientAuth.name: X-Client-ID
clientAuth.description: **Client Application ID** - Your unique application identifier used to authenticate API requests. You can find your Client ID in the Developer Settings section of the merchant dashboard.

clientSecretAuth.name: X-Client-Secret
clientSecretAuth.description: **Client Secret Key** - Your secret key used alongside the Client ID for secure authentication. Keep this confidential and never expose it in client-side code. Available in the Developer Settings section of the merchant dashboard.

merchantAuth.name: X-Merchant-ID
merchantAuth.description: **Merchant Identifier** - The unique ID for the merchant account. This is required for PSP (Payment Service Provider) merchants who manage multiple merchant accounts. You can find merchant IDs in the Merchant Management section of the dashboard.

ApiVersion.name: X-API-Version
ApiVersion.description: Optional. Send `3.0.0`. It is not a credential. The response's `X-API-Version` header echoes the value you sent, or your account's default version if you send none.
